newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary to cut import surcharge to 3 pct Thursday.
newsitem.headline: Hungary to cut import surcharge to 3 pct Thursday.

text.p: Hungary will reduce its surcharge on imported goods to three percent on Thursday from four percent, the Hungarian news agency MTI quoted the official gazette of the Hungarian government as saying.
The government decided on the reduction in March.
Hungary has international obligations to phase out the surcharge by July 1.
Hungary introduced an eight percent surcharge in March 1995 as a part of an austerity programme, which reduced the country's soaring budget and current account deficits.
